target: call_sol.sh — --batch selects the :batch model id on OpenRouter
cmd: D="$PWD/req.json"; cat "$FIXTURES/sol-transport/brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openrouter-with-cost.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$D" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter --batch >/dev/null 2>&1; jq -e ".model | endswith(\":batch\")" "$D"
